propositions: One-time backfill infers close_class for already-closed bugs lacking it, using only structural signals with no prose or LLM guessing.
A revert of a STATUS or COMMITS event yields regression; a revert only of COMMENT/LINK does not and falls through to undetermined.
A plan-review BLOCK verdict in REVIEW_RESULT history yields plan_defect, read via all_review_results.
A gate_error_v1 ERROR record on REVIEW_RESULT/COMPLETION_VERDICT streams yields env_integration, detected via raw event-file scan rather than all_review_results.
Backfilled records are written to a dedicated git-tracked NDJSON artifact, labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, kept segregated from authoritative close_class.
The script is idempotent by ticket_id and skips bugs with authoritative close_class, with a dry-run mode that prints without writing.
